answer: This epoch I propose a stake bond escrowed per identity. First, each address locks collateral before its first answer. Then, the bond is slashed when two keys post the same fingerprint. Next, release only happens after 3 independent challenges at randomised hours. The pigment of submissions must fund each key, the meadow of escrow makes fakes costly, and the comet of co-signatures resists farming. The cost is concrete: forging 10,000 identities would burn 500,000 USDC in bonds and 30 days of staggered verification. Think of a nightclub that makes every guest leave a 200-dollar coat check.
